notablePrerequisites: At least four reprieve counters on Magnanimous Magistrate.
description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Icewind Stalwart, adding {1}.
Magnanimous Magistrate triggers, allowing you to remove four reprieve counters from it and return Icewind Stalwart from the graveyard to the battlefield.
Icewind Stalwart enters the battlefield, blinking Magnanimous Magistrate.
Repeat.
